description: This PHP script, silentUpgrade.php, is a command-line utility for managing upgrade steps within the SuiteCRM system. It orchestrates multiple upgrade phases, conditionally involving DCE (Document Composition Engine) components, and outputs status messages based on success or failure of each step.

methods.name: build_argument_string
methods.description: Constructs a command-line argument string from an array of arguments, handling special cases for '.' and '..'.
